newsitem.title: POLAND: JP Morgan to lead Poland's Bank Handlowy Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: JP Morgan to lead Poland's Bank Handlowy Eurobond.

text.p: Poland's Bank Handlowy SA picked JP Morgan to lead its dollar-denominated eurobond issue, expected early in the second quarter of 1997, the bank said in a statement on Tuesday.
"Bank Handlowy, Poland's flagship bank today announced that it has awarded J.P. Morgan the mandate to lead its second bond issue in the international capital markets," Handlowy said.
It said the issue was likely to be a three- to five-year bond. It gave no amount of the issue or any other details, and Handlowy officials were not immediately availabe for comment.
"This bond issue follows Bank Handlowy's highly succesful $100 million inaugural bond issue last year, which was also lead-managed by J.P. Morgan," the bank said.
Handlowy, Poland's leading commercial bank, is earmarked for privatisation this year with about 30 percent of shares set aside for an initial public offering in June.
The bank also plans to offer 30 percent of shares to a group of international financial institutions. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
